title: DavisSN-UG: intraoperative microelectrode recordings in human substantia nigra and globus pallidus during a social ultimatum game (Davis et al., 2025)
description: Intraoperative single-unit microelectrode recordings from the human substantia nigra and globus pallidus in neurosurgical patients undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while playing a social ultimatum game. The dataset includes wideband microelectrode and macro-contact recordings, along with task synchronization events, to study how single neurons encode social learning signals. It is a BIDS conversion of a figshare release, covering 24 participants and 67 runs.
methods_description: Wideband raw streams were recorded at 44 kHz with Alpha Omega systems from the microelectrode tip and the macro contact of the same lead during DBS surgery. Participants played a social ultimatum game. Integer counts were scaled to microvolts and written as BrainVision float32 files. Digital-input TTL edges were converted to events.tsv, and the side, track and depth of each run come from the Alpha Omega file names.
